name: zp2tf
comment: Sig [b,a]=zp2tf(z,p,k): zero/pole/gain -> transfer function. Real zeros {1,2}, poles {3,4}, k=5: b=k*conv([1 -1],[1 -2])=[5 -15 10], a=conv([1 -3],[1 -4])=[1 -7 12]. Complex-conjugate poles 0.3+-0.4i with one zero 0.5, k=2: bc=[2 -1], ac=[1 -0.6 0.25] (real coeffs from the conjugate pair).
